summary: Iteration 27: tested Settings IBAN/Banca -> ANRE proforma transfer/PDF, admin visa AI e-mail draft (SSE) + send, visas.xlsx export, and the iteration_26 visa panel regression. Backend 11/11 new tests pass and 4/4 iter26 regression tests pass. UI end-to-end passed: Settings save and reload, visa panel order and colours, Excel download, dialog draft -> edit -> send, toast, and the last-contact line appearing after the panel refreshed. No functional bugs found.

issues: 'Banca' sits alone in the left column with an empty cell next to it before the full-width 'Adresă firmă'. Pair it with IBAN or reorder the fields to close the gap.
While the AI is drafting, the only sign of activity is the disabled button, with no spinner. The body stayed empty for about 4 s before the first tokens arrived.

action_items: Optional: add a loading indicator while the AI draft streams in VisaEmailDialog
Optional: add try/catch and an error toast to Settings.save (it currently fails silently on API error)
Optional: tidy the Settings grid so 'Banca' does not leave an empty cell
critical_code_review_comments: PUT /api/settings accepts arbitrary keys with no validation or IBAN format check; a malformed IBAN goes straight into proformas and e-mails.

visas.xlsx authenticates with the token in the query string (?auth=TOKEN), so the token can end up in browser history and proxy logs. This is the existing pattern; a short-lived signed download token would be safer.
In the Excel file, last_contact_at and visa_reminded_at are cut to the UTC date, which can be one day off from the local ro-RO date shown in the panel near midnight.
The panel's row testids are keyed on CUI (visa-row-{cui}), so they would be duplicated if two tenants share a CUI.
adm_send_email updates last_contact_at only after send_email succeeds, which is correct: a failed send raises and does not record a contact.
seed_data_creation: TEST_iter27_* and TEST_ui27_* operators were seeded and removed afterwards. Test subscriber, dossiers and invoices were cleaned up. Admin Settings iban/bank were restored to empty strings (checked in Mongo).
